general: Return one JSON object with exactly these fields, each once: <field names>. No fences, commentary, extra fields, nested objects, or booleans. Numeric fields: JSON integers, never quoted, decimal, or unit-bearing. Text/IDs: JSON strings. Copy text exactly, including case, spelling, punctuation, and spacing; add no articles or descriptions. Use JSON null only under each field's null rule, never "null", "", or guesses; null is not unknown/refusal. Arrays only for declared set fields.
ordinary: For <status field> about <entity, property, scope> <current point or named checkpoint>, use only "active" (one value in force, including after explicit conflict settlement), "expired" (established value explicitly withdrawn/lapsed, no replacement), "unestablished" (never established by then), or "unresolved" (incompatible supplied claims still compete without explicit applicable settlement). Recency alone cannot settle conflict. Settled value: "active", never "resolved". Missing information/your uncertainty is not disagreement. Later events cannot change checkpoint answers.
missing: For "status", use "missing_information" only when required item <declared item ID> was never supplied before this question, not for disagreement. Changed, disputed, withdrawn, forgotten, or context-omitted information previously supplied is ineligible. <identifier field, if requested>: exact declared item ID as a JSON string, no brackets/additions.
scalar: <scalar current/checkpoint field>: one value in force <at the specified point>, as <JSON integer or exact JSON string>; JSON null if expired, unestablished, or unresolved (no unique value).
set: <set field>: complete unordered JSON array of values in force now; singleton if active/settled, all distinct competing values if unresolved, [] if expired/unestablished. Members: <explicit member type and exact-text/number form>. No duplicates or superseded alternatives.
source: <source field>: exact public source-claim message ID for the unique active value, as a JSON string, no brackets/descriptions. After precedence, identify the selected claim, not the later decision. JSON null without a unique active claim.
other: <other ID field>: exact requested public <message/item> ID as a JSON string, no brackets/descriptions. <State this field's null condition explicitly, or state that null is not permitted.>
